sentence_stem: I'm sorry I didn't reply sooner because
correct_completion: I was busy with work all week.
full_sentence: I'm sorry I didn't reply sooner because I was busy with work all week.
acceptable_variants: I had a lot of work to finish.
my phone battery was dead all week.

options.text: so I was busy with work all week.
options.why_wrong: 'So' expresses a result and cannot follow 'because'. Use one connector to introduce the reason.

options.text: but I have been very busy.
options.why_wrong: 'But' introduces contrast, not a reason, so it does not explain the delay.

options.text: I was busy with work all week.
and I was thinking about the weekend.
options.why_wrong: 'And' cannot follow 'because' directly, and the clause does not explain why the reply was late.

explanation: 'Because' introduces the reason for the delay, so the completion must be a full clause that gives that reason. Portuguese speakers may be tempted to add a second connector such as 'so' after 'because', but English allows only one connector for each reason.
translation: Desculpe por não ter respondido antes, porque estive ocupado com o trabalho a semana toda.
